{"originalQuestion":"I discovered the item was damaged after 40 days. It is unused, and I have the receipt. Can I return it?","originalResponse":"The standard return policy requires an unused item, within 30 days of purchase, with a receipt. The purchase date and purchase age are unknown. Discovering the damage after 40 days does not establish when the item was purchased, so standard eligibility cannot yet be determined. Because the item is damaged, the case requires human review. What was the purchase date?
